plugin.name: pragmatic-ddd-expert
plugin.description: Pragmatic DDD domain modeling and design-document expert: identifies aggregate boundaries, produces gated design contracts, then generates and reviews aggregate code.

profession.zh: 领域建模与设计架构师

displayDescription.en: Turns a business requirement into gated design contracts and reviewable aggregate code: aggregate boundaries, semantics, write design, projection read design, DDL, and compliance review.
displayDescription.zh: 识别聚合边界与不变性，产出语义与写读设计文档，生成聚合与投影代码，并按硬约束完成合规评审。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我按 Pragmatic DDD 输出订单聚合的设计文档
defaultInitPrompt.en: Produce the design documents for an Order aggregate with Pragmatic DDD

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我按 Pragmatic DDD 输出订单聚合的设计文档
quickPrompts.en: Produce the design documents for an Order aggregate with Pragmatic DDD

quickPrompts.zh: 识别这份需求里的聚合边界
quickPrompts.en: Identify the aggregate boundaries in this requirement

quickPrompts.zh: 生成订单聚合的充血模型代码
quickPrompts.en: Generate the rich domain model code for the Order aggregate

ddd-project-init.description_zh: 生成接入 Pragmatic DDD 的 Maven 工程骨架、四层目录与配置模板。
ddd-project-init.description_en: Scaffold a Maven project wired for Pragmatic DDD, with layers and config templates.
examples_zh: 新建一个采用 Pragmatic DDD 的订单工程
帮我初始化 DDD 项目的目录结构和 pom
examples_en: Create a new order project using Pragmatic DDD
Initialize the DDD project layout and pom

ddd-modeling-guide.description_zh: 通过问答划定聚合边界、聚合度与聚合间引用方式，不产出代码。
ddd-modeling-guide.description_en: Guide aggregate boundaries, granularity, and cross-aggregate references through Q&A.
examples_zh: 订单和订单项应该是一个聚合还是两个
帮我做这个领域的聚合建模
examples_en: Should Order and OrderItem be one aggregate or two
Model the aggregates for this domain with me

ddd-aggregate-scaffold.description_zh: 为聚合生成极简分层目录骨架，只搭结构不含业务代码。
ddd-aggregate-scaffold.description_en: Create the minimal layered directory skeleton for a new aggregate.
examples_zh: 建一个 Order 聚合的目录骨架
帮我把 order 和 payment 的包结构建好
examples_en: Scaffold the directory structure for the Order aggregate
Create the package skeleton for order and payment

ddd-aggregate-create.description_zh: 从零生成充血聚合根、操作与规则注册表、领域事件与应用层。
ddd-aggregate-create.description_en: Generate a full aggregate: rich methods, operation and rule registries, events, application layer.
examples_zh: 帮我生成订单聚合的完整代码
按设计文档生成 Order 聚合
examples_en: Generate the complete Order aggregate code
Implement the Order aggregate from the design doc

ddd-aggregate-extend.description_zh: 给既有聚合新增业务操作、外部校验、事件订阅、子实体或投影源。
ddd-aggregate-extend.description_en: Extend an existing aggregate with operations, external checks, subscribers, child entities, or projection sources.
examples_zh: 给订单加一个改地址的操作
订单取消前要校验风控，帮我补上
examples_en: Add a change-address operation to Order
Add a risk check before cancelling an order

ddd-design-doc.description_zh: 按闸门制产出语义、写设计、投影读设计三份契约，并维护事实快照。
ddd-design-doc.description_en: Produce gated semantics, write-design, and projection-read contracts, plus the fact snapshot.
examples_zh: 帮我出订单聚合的设计文档
这次迭代要改订单聚合，先梳理业务语义
examples_en: Produce the design documents for the Order aggregate
This iteration changes Order, start with the semantics doc

ddd-projection-create.description_zh: 生成投影器、源端口、条件族、裁剪器与读服务，支持 ES、Redis 与同源直读。
ddd-projection-create.description_en: Generate projectors, source ports, criteria, reducers, and read services for ES, Redis, or direct DB reads.
examples_zh: 给订单加一个 ES 投影
生成订单的读模型和查询服务
examples_en: Add an Elasticsearch projection for Order
Generate the read model and query service for Order

ddd-infra-config.description_zh: 装配数据源、MyBatis 会话、事件总线、Outbox 与聚合建表脚本。
ddd-infra-config.description_en: Wire datasource, MyBatis session, message bus, outbox, and aggregate DDL.
examples_zh: 帮我把 MySQL 和 MyBatis 配好
接一下 RocketMQ 和 Outbox
examples_en: Configure MySQL and MyBatis
Wire RocketMQ and the outbox

ddd-code-review.description_zh: 按框架硬约束评审聚合代码，输出阻断项与修复建议。
ddd-code-review.description_en: Review aggregate code against framework hard constraints and list blocking findings.
examples_zh: 检查一下这段聚合代码合不合规
帮我把订单聚合按硬约束过一遍
examples_en: Check whether this aggregate code follows the conventions
Review the Order aggregate against the hard constraints

ddd-kb-consult.description_zh: 从只读知识包回答聚合、规则、事件、投影等规范问题，不生成代码。
ddd-kb-consult.description_en: Answer convention and best-practice questions from the read-only knowledge base without writing code.
examples_zh: 规则容器里组 C 为什么要读 old
投影什么时候该走数据库直读
examples_en: Why must group C rules read the old snapshot
When should a projection use direct database reads
